text: If val_mse_ratio is replaced by absolute val MSE, or by the fraction of step-0 val MSE, as the matching variable, is the N=128 minus N=256 trained force R2 gap at matched loss still at least 0.04 in seeds 24-25? Does the same matched-loss comparison on data_seed 1 (seeds 20-21) show a gap, given that its matched-step trained R2 was flat?
